439.name: Heavy Buckle Belt
439.description:
A belt with its buckle reinforced to be used as a quick striking weapon.
Can inflict Nausea on hit.

440.name: Cheap Sword
440.description: A poorly forged sword with a dull edge and weak metal that chips easily.

441.name: Budget Axe
441.description: A mass-produced axe with a loose head that wobbles when swung.

442.name: Apprentice Staff
442.description:
A flimsy staff made from green wood that bends when struck with force.
Strikes with Water.

443.name: Flimsy Bow
443.description:
A crude bow made from a weak, knotted wood that might snap at any
moment.

444.name: Crude Spear
444.description:
A simple spear with a dull iron tip that bends on impact. Can inflict
Poison on hit.

445.name: Shoddy Knuckles
445.description:
Poorly tanned leather gloves with small metal studs that come loose
easily. Can inflict Stun on hit.

446.name: Bargain Knife
446.description:
A poorly balanced knife with a handle that comes loose from the blade.
Can inflict Blind on hit.

447.name: Pot Metal Mace
447.description: A mace with a head made from weak pot metal that dents easily.

448.name: Unreliable Crossbow
448.description:
A crossbow with a weak firing mechanism that often fails to launch bolts
properly. Can inflict Blind on hit.

449.name: Dull Claws
449.description: Poorly crafted claws made from weak metal that dulls quickly.

450.name: Unreliable Pistol
450.description: A pistol made from substandard parts that frequently jams and misfires.

451.name: Unwieldy Hammer
451.description: A giant hammer that's too heavy for its poorly made handle.

452.name: Cracked Whip
452.description: A whip made from poorly tanned leather that cracks and splits easily.

453.name: Training Sword
453.description: A worn-out training sword with a blunted edge and splintering handle.

454.name: Rusty Rifle
454.description:
An ancient rifle with a rusty barrel and worn firing mechanism. Can
inflict Stun on hit.

455.name: Dented Pan
455.description: A dented frying pan pressed into service as a makeshift weapon.

456.name: Stretchy Sling
456.description:
A sling made from poor quality leather that stretches unpredictably. Can
inflict Blind on hit.

457.name: Splintered Club
457.description:
A wooden club with splits and cracks running through it. Can inflict
Stun on hit.

458.name: Walking Stick
458.description:
A walking stick repurposed as a weapon, with a weak shaft that flexes
too much. Ice, inflicts Cold.

459.name: Leaky Blowgun
459.description: A blow dart tube made from a cracked reed that leaks air.

460.name: Practice Axe
460.description:
A wooden practice axe with a dulled edge for training purposes. Can
inflict Stun on hit.

461.name: Warped Arrows
461.description: Cheap arrows with warped shafts and poorly attached fletching.

462.name: Makeshift Boxing Gloves
462.description:
Thin leather gloves with small iron nuggets sewn in that shift position.
Can inflict Stun on hit.

463.name: Decorative Sword
463.description: A mass-produced ceremonial sword with no edge, meant for display only.

464.name: Loose-headed Spear
464.description: A spear with a head attached by loose bindings that might come undone.

465.name: Tin Claws
465.description: Metal claws fashioned from cheap tin that bend out of shape easily.

466.name: Novice Wand
466.description:
A wand made from poor quality wood with minimal magical conductivity.
Strikes with Water.

467.name: Uneven Slingshot
467.description:
A handmade slingshot with an uneven fork and weak elastic. Can inflict
Blind on hit.

468.name: Rusty Sickle
468.description:
A farming sickle repurposed as a weapon, with a loose handle and spotted
rust.

469.name: Wooden Flail
469.description: A flail with a lightweight wooden head that causes minimal damage.

470.name: Misaligned Hand Crossbow
470.description: A pistol crossbow made from weak wood that frequently needs realignment.

471.name: Unbalanced Throwing Knife
471.description: A poorly balanced throwing knife that wobbles in flight.

472.name: Beginner's Hand Wraps
472.description:
Flimsy leather hand wraps with small metal bits for striking. Can
inflict Stun on hit.

473.name: Toy Bow
473.description:
A toy bow made from flexible plastic with weak elastic string. Can
inflict Blind on hit.

474.name: Wooden Play Sword
474.description: A wooden sword used by children for playtime battles.

475.name: Carved Stick
475.description:
A stick with crude carvings meant to resemble a magical staff. Strikes
with Fire.

476.name: Suction Cup Dart Gun
476.description: A dart gun that uses suction cups instead of pointed tips.

477.name: Foam Toy Axe
477.description: A plastic toy axe with soft foam edges for safety.

478.name: Fly Swatter
478.description:
A swatter typically used for insects, made from lightweight plastic. Can
inflict Provoke on hit.

479.name: Stale Baguette
479.description:
A stick of bread that's gone stale and hard as a rock. Can inflict Stun
on hit.

480.name: Sarcastic Pillow
480.description:
A sentient pillow that smacks enemies with surprising force and
occasionally whispers insults at them. Inflicts Stun.

481.name: Spud Launcher Deluxe
481.description:
A potato gun that fires genetically modified exploding potatoes that
detonate on impact.

482.name: Phantom Tickle Gloves
482.description:
Gloves that summon ghostly hands to tickle enemies into submission,
causing uncontrollable laughter. Sacred, inflicts Inspired.

483.name: Number One Fan
483.description:
A giant foam finger that somehow hits with the force of a sledgehammer
while making cartoon sound effects. Inflicts Stun.

484.name: Extreme T-Shirt Cannon
484.description:
A modified t-shirt cannon that fires shirts so hard they can knock down
castle walls. Can inflict Stun on hit.

485.name: Combatant Angler
485.description:
A fishing rod that catches and weaponizes random sea creatures to fight
for you. Water, inflicts Wet.

486.name: Master Flipper
486.description:
A spatula that flips enemies as easily as pancakes, temporarily
reversing their controls. Inflicts Stun.

487.name: Peppermint Scepter
487.description:
A staff made from a giant candy cane that shoots peppermint beams and
makes enemies smell delicious. Thunder, inflicts Static.

488.name: Bounce Bubble Blower
488.description:
A bubble wand that creates unbreakable bubbles that trap enemies and
bounce them around the battlefield. Thunder, inflicts Static.

489.name: Honking Mallet Duo
489.description:
A pair of squeaky toy hammers that create shockwaves when squeaked
together. Can inflict Stun on hit.

490.name: EMP Disruptor
490.description:
A handheld electromagnetic pulse device that disables electronic systems
and cybernetic implants. Water, inflicts Wet.

491.name: Pepper Spray Cannon
491.description:
A spray canister that fires concentrated capsaicin for non-lethal crowd
control. Can inflict Blind on hit.

492.name: Taser Rifle
492.description:
A weapon that fires electroshock darts to incapacitate targets
non-lethally. Fire, inflicts Hot.

493.name: Drone Swarm Launcher
493.description: A shoulder-mounted device that launches small autonomous attack drones.

494.name: Spiked Battle Shield
494.description:
A reinforced shield with spikes and a razor edge that can be used for
devastating shield bashes. Inflicts Stun.

495.name: War Pick
495.description: A military hammer with a pick on the reverse side for penetrating armor.

496.name: Naval Cutlass
496.description:
A curved naval sword designed for close-quarters combat on ships. Can
inflict Poison on hit.

497.name: Boarding Pike
497.description: A long pike designed for repelling boarders on ships.

498.name: Naval Dirk
498.description:
A short dagger used by sailors for shipboard combat and utility work.
Can inflict Blind on hit.

499.name: Sword Breaker
499.description: A specialized sword designed to catch and break enemy blades.

500.name: Francisca
500.description: A Frankish throwing axe designed for both melee and ranged combat.

501.name: Glaive
501.description: A polearm with a curved blade, effective against cavalry.

502.name: Flanged War Mace
502.description: A heavy mace with flanged head designed to crush armor.

503.name: Steel Cable Whip
503.description: A whip made from braided steel cable that can slice through armor.

504.name: Neural Scrambler
504.description:
A device that generates a localized electromagnetic field to disrupt
neural activity. Strikes with Thunder.

505.name: Phase Blade
505.description:
A sword that exists partially in another dimension, allowing it to phase
through defenses. Strikes with Water.

506.name: Symbiotic Blade
506.description: A living weapon that bonds with its wielder, growing stronger over time.

507.name: Chronos Hammer
507.description:
A weapon that slows time around targets when it strikes. Strikes with
Water and can inflict Wet.

508.name: Metamorphic Gauntlets
508.description: Gauntlets that can transform into various weapon forms at will.

509.name: Modular Combat Rifle
509.description:
A rifle with interchangeable barrels and modular components for
different combat situations.

510.name: Multi-Bolt Crossbow
510.description:
A crossbow that fires different types of specialized bolts for various
effects. Strikes with Thunder.

511.name: Cyber Warfare Device
511.description:
A device that hacks into enemy systems and turns them against their
allies. Strikes with Fire.

512.name: Variable Chain Hammer
512.description: A meteor hammer with extendable chain length for variable range attacks.

513.name: Infinite Quiver Bow
513.description:
A bow that creates arrows from ambient energy, never running out of
ammunition. Ice, inflicts Cold.

514.name: Returning Discus
514.description:
A circular blade weapon that returns to the thrower after striking
targets.

515.name: Energy Lash
515.description:
A whip made from pure energy that can extend to great lengths. Strikes
with Fire.

516.name: Timed Explosive Launcher
516.description:
A launcher that fires timed explosive charges with adjustable detonation
delays.

517.name: Siege Breaker
517.description:
A massive two-handed mace designed to shatter fortifications. Can
inflict Stun on hit.

518.name: Life Drain Claws
518.description:
Claws that drain the life force of targets and transfer it to the
wielder. Can inflict Poison on hit.

519.name: Gravity Manipulation Staff
519.description:
A staff that manipulates gravitational fields to crush or lift enemies.
Strikes with Ice.

520.name: Smart Tracking Rifle
520.description:
A sniper rifle with smart ammunition that tracks and adjusts its
trajectory mid-flight. Strikes with Cursed.

521.name: Dimensional Cleaver
521.description:
An axe that cleaves through multiple dimensions, hitting enemies in
parallel realities. Sacred, inflicts Inspired.

522.name: Temporal Echo Whip
522.description:
A whip that exists in multiple timelines simultaneously, striking the
same target multiple times. Cursed.

523.name: Adaptive Combat AI
523.description:
A weapon system that learns from combat and adapts its tactics and
ammunition type. Cursed, inflicts Poison.

524.name: Molecular Manipulator Gloves
524.description:
Gauntlets that allow the wearer to manipulate matter at the molecular
level. Cursed, inflicts Poison.

525.name: Quantum Superposition Blade
525.description:
A sword that exists in a state of quantum superposition, striking all
possible targets simultaneously. Ice.

526.name: Universal Force Staff
526.description:
A staff that channels the fundamental forces of the universe itself.
Strikes with Sacred.

527.name: Reality Distortion Cannon
527.description:
A reality-warping weapon that can rewrite the laws of physics in a
localized area. Ice, inflicts Cold.

528.name: Omniadaptive Combat System
528.description:
The ultimate expression of combat technology, capable of adapting to any
threat.

529.name: Seed Dagger
529.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword. Can inflict Poison on hit.

530.name: Seed Sword
530.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword. Can inflict Poison on hit.

531.name: Seed Mace
531.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword.

532.name: Seed Axe
532.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword.

533.name: Seed Whip
533.description:
A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword. Can inflict Provoke on
hit.

534.name: Seed Staff
534.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword. Strikes with Sacred.

535.name: Seed Bow
535.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword. Can inflict Blind on hit.

536.name: Seed Grimorie
536.description:
A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword. Strikes with Ice and can
inflict Cold.

537.name: Seed Gun
537.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword.

538.name: Seed Claw
538.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword. Can inflict Poison on hit.

539.name: Seed Glove
539.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword.

540.name: Seed Spear
540.description: A light and easy-to-wield short-bladed sword. Can inflict Poison on hit.

541.name: Busker's Acoustic
541.description: A battered dreadnought with three strings left, swung by the neck.

542.name: Presidential Saxophone
542.description:
A brass tenor sax, played on late night television and swung when the
questions get harder.

543.name: Pawnshop Stratocaster
543.description:
A copy of a copy, bought secondhand and never quite in tune. Can inflict
Stun on hit.

544.name: La chitarra infernale
544.description:
A cherry burst superstrat, quilted and shark-finned. It is louder than
the room and hotter than the amp. Sacred.

545.name: Flying V
545.description:
A guitar shaped like the thing it is used as. Nobody has to explain this
one twice. Can inflict Stun on hit.

546.name: Bass Guitar
546.description:
Four strings, a long neck and a great deal of mass. The low end is felt
rather than heard. Inflicts Stun.

547.name: Double-Neck Warhorse
547.description:
Twelve strings above, six below, and a strap that has taken more weight
than any strap should.

548.name: Feedback Cannon
548.description:
A guitar wired straight into a stack that is no longer there. It still
howls.

549.name: Hellfire Superstrat
549.description:
The neck runs the whole length of the body and the body has been on fire
since the day it was strung. Fire.

550.name: Il bastone infernale
550.description:
A gentleman's cane with a skull grip. The shaft is a scabbard, and what
it sheathes is not polite. Ice, inflicts Cold.
